title: feat(plugin-map): a map view with no style draws the deployment's default map style before demotiles
body:
Fixes #26163

Clause-②: no
Metadata-protocol: none

The ui half of #26001. A map view that declares no style of its own now draws the deployment's default style, the runtime-config `mapStyleUrl` that #26162 serves from the operator's `OS_CONSOLE_MAP_STYLE_URL`, before it falls back to the public demo style.

## What changed

A map draws the first style it finds, in this order:

1. the view's own style: `mapStyle`, then `map.style` (unchanged);
2. the deployment's default style, from the host;
3. `DEFAULT_MAP_STYLE`, the public demo style (unchanged).

- **`@object-ui/react`**: a new `HostMapStyleContext` with `HostMapStyleProvider` and `useHostMapStyle()`. Outside a provider, or with no style given, the hook answers `undefined`.
- **`@object-ui/plugin-map`**: `ObjectMap` reads `useHostMapStyle()` after `mapConfig.style`. Its public exports are unchanged. When the deployment's style fails to load, the record-list notice now has its own text: the default map style set for this deployment could not be loaded, ask your administrator to check it. Before this change that case would have shown the default-style notice, which blames the public default tiles that the map never drew.
- **`@object-ui/app-shell`**: `AppShellRuntimeConfig.mapStyleUrl?: string` is read from the top-level `mapStyleUrl`. It is re-read from each payload, so absent, empty or non-string values withdraw it. `ConsoleShell` mounts `HostMapStyleProvider` with `getRuntimeConfig().mapStyleUrl`, directly inside `HostNavigationBridge`.
- **`@object-ui/i18n`**: one key, `element.map.styleFailedDeployment`, in all ten packs.
- Docs: a "Which style draws" section in `plugin-map`'s README and in `content/docs/plugins/plugin-map.mdx`.
- `scripts/sdui-manifest.sources/{i18n,plugin-map,react}.json` re-recorded. The artefact itself did not move.

## The seam: a context in `@object-ui/react`, not a prop and not a plugin-map export

- **Not a prop.** `ObjectMap` reaches the page through `ComponentRegistry` (`object-map`, rendered by `ObjectView` / `ListView` / `SchemaRenderer`). The Console never builds that element, so it has nowhere to pass a prop. `HostNavigationContext` exists for the same reason, and `ConsoleShell`'s own comment says so.
- **Not a context exported from `plugin-map`.** The Console loads `@object-ui/plugin-map` lazily (`registerLazy` in `apps/console/src/register-plugins.ts`) to keep maplibre-gl out of the first bundle. A provider imported from the plugin's single side-effectful entry would load the plugin, and maplibre-gl with it, on every page.
- **So the context sits beside `HostNavigationContext` in `@object-ui/react`.** Both the plugin and the app-shell already depend on that package, so neither gains a dependency, and `plugin-map` still does not depend on `app-shell`. `plugin-map`'s public surface is unchanged. `@object-ui/react` gains three exports: the context, the provider and the hook.

No spec key and no Setup setting were added (ruling A on #26001).

## Tests

Pinned in `ObjectMap.deploymentStyle-26163.test.tsx`, driven through `HostMapStyleProvider`:

- env set and no view style: the deployment style draws. Covered for the declared `map` block and for the flat ListView form.
- env unset: demotiles. Covered both with a provider that gives no style and with no provider at all.
- the view's own `mapStyle` wins, and so does `map.style`.
- a failed deployment style gets the deployment notice, and a failed view style still gets the view notice.

`ConsoleShell.mapStyle-26163.test.tsx` checks that the console supplies the served value, and supplies nothing when the runtime serves no `mapStyleUrl`. `runtime-config.test.ts` gains a `mapStyleUrl` block covering read, absent, empty, whitespace, non-string, nested under `branding`, and withdrawn.

Red first, at the pre-change `ObjectMap.tsx` (`10e80921`) with the tests in place, under the verify lock:

```
× env set, no view style: draws the deployment style
× env set, no view style, flat-form config: draws the deployment style
× a failed deployment style names the deployment style, not the public default tiles
Tests  3 failed | 62 passed (65)
```

After the restore, the file matched its HEAD blob (`git diff HEAD` empty), and the green leg read `Tests 65 passed (65)`. The env-unset and view-wins cases pass on both legs, because they pin behaviour that already existed.

Ablation of the Console injection: replacing `styleUrl={getRuntimeConfig().mapStyleUrl}` with `styleUrl={undefined}` turns `hands the served mapStyleUrl to every renderer below it` red (1 failed, 1 passed). After the restore, the file's hash matched HEAD.

## Local verification at head `3f5e3446`

These were run after merging `origin/main` (merge commit `10e1f91a`), under `scripts/pm/os-verify-lock.sh`:

- Tests: `pnpm exec vitest run packages/plugin-map/ packages/i18n/ packages/react/src/context` plus the three `ConsoleShell` tests (`hostNavigation`, `mapStyle-26163`, `notifications`), `runtime-config.test.ts`, `ObjectView.mapFlatten.test.tsx` and `InterfaceListPage.mapConfig.test.tsx`. Result: `Test Files 149 passed (149)`, `Tests 1862 passed, 13 skipped`.
- `pnpm run type-check` in `plugin-map`, `react`, `i18n` and `app-shell`: all exit 0 with 0 TS errors. This was run after `turbo run build --filter='@object-ui/app-shell^...'`, which completed 64 of 64 tasks.
- `node scripts/gen-sdui-manifest-node.mjs` re-recorded `i18n`, `plugin-map` and `react`, and the artefact sha256 did not change. `node scripts/check-sdui-manifest.mjs` exits 0.
- `eslint` on the changed files: 0 errors (warnings only, of the same kinds the neighbouring files already carry). `pnpm --dir ui run check:new-line-citations`: 0 new citations.
- `node scripts/pm/dispatch-gates.mjs --commands --repo objectstack-ai/objectstack` derived 45 commands. 44 exited 0. `pnpm check:type-check-debt` is **NOT MEASURED**: it exited 3 (PREREQUISITE NOT MET) because its closure build timed out in the shared verify-lock queue, so CI's run of it is the reading. `--ran` reconciliation: `45 derived, 44 run, 1 NOT-MEASURED, 0 UNRUN`.
- Not run locally: the full app-shell suite and the repo-wide lint. CI runs both.

## Acceptance notes

- The `object-map` `mapStyle` input description is the spec row's describe, verbatim: "overriding the public demo tiles". With a deployment default it now overrides that too. The text lives in `@objectstack/spec`, outside this card, so it was left as is. The README and docs rows are updated.
- `docs/qa/platform-checklist/RUNNER.md` records a QA reading that the map uses demotiles unless the view declares a style. That reading is historical, tied to its pin, and was left as is.
- The default-style notice still tells the reader to ask an administrator to "set a map style for this view". That remedy remains valid, and setting `OS_CONSOLE_MAP_STYLE_URL` is now a second one. The translated text was left unchanged.
